title: Gridlock+
tagline: Adding a staking & attack layer on top of the Gridlock game.
description: Gridlock has a resource farming & soldier creation mechanism but lacks pvp mechanics, I'm adding the ability for players to stake tokens on their land, which allows them to attack other players to steal their stake. The amount that can be stolen is proportional to the amount staked.
how_its_made:
Next, Typecript, Viem on the frontend, Foundry & Solidity for the contracts.
